title: gRPC protobuf and HTTP/2 binding
summary: gRPC dev3 implements schema-bound protobuf through Serialisation Selector, strict gRPC message framing, outbound HTTP/2 unary calls and an outbound HTTP/2 server-streaming callback client. Native streaming fixture exercised an independent hyper-h2 endpoint; the ooRexx bridge was not fully qualified in dev3.
invariants: gRPC pathname resolves through GrpcMethodRegistry then the shared RpcServiceRegistry; path never names a raw ooRexx method.
Only selected protobuf schemas/codec provider may serialize a registered operation.
HTTP/2 trailers and final grpc-status control terminal outcome, not just receipt of a message.
Client-streaming, bidirectional streaming and inbound HTTP/2 server dispatch remain unimplemented.
The r13196 native ooRexx bridge callback was not executed/compiled against the matching SDK in dev3; 15 native fixture checks are NOT end-to-end runtime proof.

provenance.claim: Source inspected locally in exact package bytes.
